subject: Quick note on BB Fabrication's website
bodyText:
Hi,

I'm Mani from Rogue.

We look for solid businesses that still look stuck online - and BB Fabrication stood out.

Tipton metalwork for gates, beams and staircases - yet bbfabrication.co.uk still drops Latin filler ("Congue accumsan vulputate...") mid-page and leaves the experience counters stuck at zero. Real fabrication shop; unfinished web copy.

If useful, I'll send a short 3-point teardown over email - what's dated, what's costing you, and the first fix. No call required.

Reply YES and I'll send it.
